Across the PONs is an international collaborative of network scholars, ranging
from doctoral students to emeritus professors, working collectively to build a cross-national database on purpose-oriented networks.

## Joining the collaborative

Across the PONs operates under a data-use and sharing agreement that allows new
members to join and contribute cases to the shared database. Scholars interested
in deploying the instruments or contributing data are welcome to get in touch with the coordinating committee: 

{{< include _contact.qmd >}}
